description: Factors of the end-to-end harness options matrix (docs/test-plan/04-e2e-test-plan.md §2). The covering arrays are generated from this file by scripts/e2e_covering_array.py; the constraints live in that script, next to the generator that must respect them, and are copied into each generated array.

factors.label: Chat mode
factors.notes: plain = assistant chat without tools; internal_search = assistant knowledge mode; universal = Universal Agent Mode (wire chatMode 'agent'); plan_execute also covers 'verification'. The last four are legacy-only today (rollout.ts) and become durable as LAT1/CPD-10 move them.

factors.label: Turn action
factors.notes: reconnect = drop the SSE connection mid-stream and resume with Last-Event-ID.

factors.label: Deployment path setting
factors.notes: durable = defaults (replica set, relay and worker on, Labs on); kill_switch = the operator's instance stop, AGENT_HARNESS_KILL_SWITCH=true on Node (CTL-5; Labs "Agent harness" off is org_disabled, not this level); standalone_mongo = infrastructure_unavailable. The effective path also depends on the mode.

factors.label: Engine
factors.notes: none = loop run. Claude Code 2.1.294 is admitted (CC1); its rows run like every engine's (QA-31).

factors.label: Sub-agent role model
factors.notes: The agent's roleModels (MA1, QA-37). none = the agent sets no role model, as before MA1: a child calls its parent's model; same = the role `default` is set to the turn's own model; different = it is set to another model the org allows; forbidden = it is set to a model the org's models.routes excludes (enforced with CONTROL_PLANE_PIN=on). A level other than none needs a turn that spawns a child run (deep mode on a loop run). Pairwise only: not in threeWiseCore (04 §2.1).

factors.label: Model provider and wire format
factors.notes: Scripted lanes serve every wire from deployment/e2e/fake_llm; live lanes use the providers the budget allows (Azure OpenAI today).

factors.label: Flow guard
factors.notes: off = HARNESS_FLOW_GUARD=false; ask = default; org_deny = the org's approval policy sets the flow rule to deny (SEC2 O-1).

factors.label: User decision on a prompt
factors.notes: none = no prompt is expected for this row; the others are what the user does when the card appears.

factors.label: Tool family exercised
factors.notes: toolset = a connector toolset (Jira-shaped against deployment/e2e/fake_saas); mcp = an HTTP MCP server (fake); run_code = sandboxed code; skills = a pinned skill; memory = governed memory on.

factors.label: Sandbox profile and egress
factors.notes: broker_* = SANDBOX_MODE=broker with no network, an egress allowlist, or SANDBOX_ALLOW_NETWORK=true. Isolation runtimes (runc, gVisor, Kata) are a separate lane (04 §5.4), not a factor here.

factors.label: Asserted surface
factors.notes: user = chat only; admin = also the admin views (effectivePolicy, approvals queue, unknown-effects console, audit); operator = also metrics, logs and health.
